This card is almost certainly identical to the [[Netgear WAG511 v2]] (AR5212+AR5112) or [[Netgear WAG511 v3]] (AR5213+AR5112). Perhaps both.. if there are multiple revisions of this card.
[http://ubuntuforums.org/showthread.php?t=1237363 It appears that at least some cards use AR5213].
This device is listed in the [http://tuto.netgear-forum.com/Documentation/Chipsets/ netgear-forum chipset table].
